source_criteria: Airify PM2.5 Daily Intake Criteria v0.1
description: Operational reference tiers for ESTIMATED INHALED PM2.5 (mass) over a day, used only to color-code and trigger preventive information in the Airify demo UI. These are NOT medical safety limits, NOT a diagnosis, and NOT a clinical dose. 'Intake' here means estimated inhaled PM2.5 mass (concentration x inhalation rate x time), not absorbed or deposited dose.

units.add: mg/kg/day (environmental estimate only, not a clinical dose)

concentration_reference_bands.note: Display bands mirror frontend/src/shared/utils/risk.ts. Operational reference only.

population_profiles.note: Per task rules: children (0-18) may use ADD/HQ-based reference wording; other groups use operational reference / risk-trigger wording only. No group receives a medical guarantee of safe/unsafe.

children_0_18.description: Children may be described using ADD/HQ-based REFERENCE wording because intake per body weight is higher. Still preventive, still not a diagnosis.

pregnancy.note: Use operational reference / risk-trigger wording. Do not state pregnancy outcomes.

copd.note: Respiratory-sensitive reference trigger. No diagnosis, no treatment advice.

cvd.note: Cardiovascular-sensitive reference trigger. No diagnosis, no treatment advice.

asthma.note: Respiratory-sensitive reference trigger. No diagnosis, no treatment advice.

boundary: Environmental exposure estimate only. Not medical diagnosis. Not clinical decision support. Preventive information only.
